Name: Bionic Prosthetics
Author: playfullgamer
Description: Lost a limb? Not a problem. 35 hand-crafted prosthetics that snap onto stumps, size themselves to the wearer and bend like real limbs - from pirate peg legs and hooks to plasma arm cannons, tesla arms, drill arms, rocket legs and chrome cyber limbs. Full arms and legs bend at the elbow and knee (prosthetic legs walk in step with the healthy leg), there are prosthetic feet, and modular upper arms and thighs take any forearm or lower-leg prosthetic. Most have a special ability on activate.
